annotations.title: Suggest internal links for a page

description: Suggests which of the site’s OWN posts this post should link to, from local signals only (shared topics, categories/tags, and the candidate’s subject appearing in the text) — no AI call is spent. Each suggestion carries the target post, the exact phrase in this post’s text to link (empty when none exists — append a "See also" line instead), and a one-line reason. READ-ONLY: it suggests; to actually insert a link, edit the post through the governed update tool like any other content change.

post_id.description: The post/page ID to suggest links for.
